entries.name: Sharp penetration
entries.prompt: One isolated bullet impact into dense monster flesh. Instant sharp wet puncture and tight fibrous tear, followed by a compact low meaty thud. Crisp satisfying attack that cuts through a gunshot mix; intimate dry close-mic foley, short 250 ms decay then silence. Physical and grounded, not a punch or a UI hitmarker. No gunshot, voice, growl, music, metallic click, cartoon splat or reverb.

entries.name: Heavy wet rupture
entries.prompt: One isolated heavy bullet striking thick monster flesh. A sharp penetrating skin snap, dense wet internal crunch and sticky tissue rip, supported by a deep compact body thump. Richer and heavier than a dry puncture; tactile satisfying game combat foley. Fast attack, 350 ms viscous decay then silence. Close and dry. No gunshot, voices, scream, growl, music, metallic clang, huge explosion, comic splat or reverb.
